item.title: Krita
item.author: emecas
item.description:
Krita
https://krita.org/
Krita is a free and open source painting program for new and experienced artists. It offers multiple brush types, layers, animation tools, online resources, a supportive community and more.

Features:

- Clean and Flexible Interface

An intuitive user interface that stays out of your way. The dockers and panels can be moved and customized for your specific workflow. Once you have your setup, you can save it as your own workspace. You can also create your own shortcuts for commonly used tools.

item.title: Processing
item.author: emecas
item.description:
Processing
https://processing.org/
Processing is a flexible software sketchbook and a language for learning how to code. Since 2001, Processing has promoted software literacy within the visual arts and visual literacy within technology. There are tens of thousands of students, artists, designers, researchers, and hobbyists who use Processing for learning and prototyping.

Processing Foundation: https://processingfoundation.org/

Flavors:

- Processing {tradicional] : https://processing.org/
- p5.js : https://p5js.org/
- Processing Android : https://android.processing.org/
- Processing Python : https://py.processing.org/

item.title: Metacreation: Lab for Creative AI
item.author: emecas
item.description:
Metacreation: Lab for Creative AI
https://metacreation.net/

Driven by collaborations involving scientists, experts in artificial intelligence, cognitive sciences, designers, and artists, the Metacreation Lab for Creative AI is at the forefront of the development of generative systems, whether these are embedded in interactive experiences or automating workflows integrated into cutting-edge creative software.

Generative Systems

As automation becomes commonplace in an ever expanding range of fields, the Metacreation Lab goes further by developing systems that are capable of human-level creativity. These are systems capable of autonomous creation, producing original artwork and creative output alongside and beyond their human counterparts.

item.title: Zrythm
item.author: emecas
item.description:
Zrythm
a highly automated and intuitive digital audio workstation
https://www.zrythm.org/en/index.html

Sources:
https://sr.ht/~alextee/zrythm/

Overview

Zrythm is a cross-platform digital audio workstation designed to be featureful and easy to use.

Limitless automation
Automate almost anything with automation events using straight lines, ramps and curves, or with LFOs and envelopes.

Audio plugins
Complete support for LV2 and VST2, with experimental support for VST3, AU, SFZ and SF2.

Multi-backend support
Fully JACK aware, including support for PipeWire, JACK transport, ALSA, PulseAudio, WASAPI, Windows MME, CoreMidi and CoreAudio.

item.title: openFrameworks
item.author: emecas
item.description:
openFrameworks
https://openframeworks.cc/
openFrameworks is an open source C++ toolkit for creative coding.

Repos: https://github.com/openframeworks

Download https://openframeworks.cc/download/

Grab the most recent release (0.11.0) and follow the setup guide to get openFrameworks running.

Documentation https://openframeworks.cc/documentation/

Reference for openFrameworks classes, functions and addons. You can also check the tutorials section https://openframeworks.cc/tutorials.

Forum https://forum.openframeworks.cc/

The forum is a place to meet other people working with openFrameworks. It’s a place to share your work, or find help solving problems.
